idea-plugin.name: deepseek-harness-for-intellij
idea-plugin.description:
deepseek-harness-for-intellij integrates DeepSeek Harness (dsh) into the IDE as a chat tool window. It runs the dsh web-profile server locally and speaks its HTTP API (unary RPC + a mux event stream).

The tool window streams assistant replies with collapsible reasoning, renders tool-call cards and approval prompts, answers interactive questions, and lets you switch models and sandbox mode without leaving the IDE.
